basis: Marrow failure; limb reduction, renal agenesis and cleft palate each 1/1; ear canal atresia and bicuspid valve omitted at cap. Frequencies derive from one patient.
Inflammation of the nasopharyngeal tonsil, typically driven by infection.
CoQ10 biosynthesis disorder; encephalopathy, brain atrophy and glomerulosclerosis each reported in 1/1; both are major presentations. Myopathy frequency unclear.
Persistent fetal ocular structures cause cataract, vitreoretinal abnormalities and visual impairment; confined to the ocular axis.
Strabismus and pes cavus define the syndrome; additional skeletal abnormalities support musculoskeletal involvement. Intellectual disability is not established by the definition.
Congenital platelet-production failure with absent megakaryocytes, hypocellular marrow and progression to pancytopenia.
Defined by cortical malformation, microcephaly, cerebellar hypoplasia and brainstem hypoplasia.
Neuromuscular junction disease within ALG14 glycosylation disorders; persistent multiple joint contractures affect 6/7 patients.
Respiratory-chain disorder; ataxia 2/2, muscle pathology 3/3 with weakness, cardiomyopathy 1/2. Hearing loss and macrocytic anemia, each 1/2, omitted at cap.
Hereditary corticospinal degeneration causes spastic paraplegia; weakness is neurologic. Talipes frequency is unspecified.
TRIM32 neuromuscular umbrella includes limb-girdle muscular dystrophy. BBS-specific retinal, renal and endocrine abnormalities cannot be generalized across the group.
Gestational trophoblastic tumor arising at the placental implantation site; reproductive tissues have no axis. Metastatic sites are not defining.
Alopecia and severe intellectual disability define the syndrome and are each present in 7/7 patients.
Umbrella for sequelae of viral infection; infectious origin supports the mechanism axis. No particular organ is consistently affected across subtypes.
Patent ductus arteriosus is a congenital cardiovascular structural abnormality; no additional organ damage is established.
Trichomonas infection directly inflames the urinary bladder, which belongs to the renal axis.
Thrombosis directly affects the splenic vein. A separate coagulation disorder or common splenic tissue damage is not established.
Human Mesocestoides infection is an intestinal tapeworm infection; extraintestinal larval disease is not the usual human presentation.
Endocrine tumor syndrome; cutaneous angiofibromas 80-99% and bone loss 30-79%. Peptic ulcers and kidney stones are separately coded complications.
Loss of skin elasticity defines the umbrella. Pulmonary, vascular, skeletal and developmental damage varies by subtype without an established group-wide frequency.
Astrocytic tumor originating in the brainstem.
Humoral immunodeficiency defined by deficient or ineffective B lymphocytes. Recurrent infections do not establish common permanent damage to another organ.
MYL3-related hypertrophic cardiomyopathy directly affects cardiac muscle; no extracardiac disease is established.
Heart failure with elevated cardiac output; underlying causes and transient congestion do not establish additional directly damaged organs.
Inherited retinal dysfunction with retinal ganglion cell abnormalities, optic disc pallor and visual loss; retinal and optic nerve findings remain ocular.
